.. py:function:: _iter_subjects(dicom_root: pathlib.Path) -> list[str]

   Sorted subject directory names under *dicom_root*.


.. py:function:: _iter_nifti(folder: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Sorted ``.nii`` / ``.nii.gz`` files in *folder*.


.. py:function:: _nifti_stem(path: pathlib.Path) -> str

   Filename stem with ``.nii`` / ``.nii.gz`` suffix removed.


.. py:function:: _matching_json(nifti_path: pathlib.Path, search_dir: pathlib.Path) -> pathlib.Path | None

   Locate a JSON sidecar for *nifti_path* under *search_dir*, if present.


.. py:function:: vwi_bb_nifti_path(nifti_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Canonical black-blood NIfTI path for *subject*.


.. py:function:: vwi_bb_json_path(nifti_root: pathlib.Path, subject: str) -> pathlib.Path

   Canonical black-blood JSON sidecar path for *subject*.


.. py:function:: convert_subject(subject: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path, nifti_root: pathlib.Path, skip_existing: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   Convert ``vwi_bb`` DICOMs and write canonical ``BlackBlood/vwi_bb`` outputs.


.. py:function:: run_subject(subject: str, *, dicom_root: pathlib.Path, nifti_root: pathlib.Path, skip_existing: bool = False) -> pathlib.Path

   CLI entry: convert one subject (alias for :func:`convert_subject`).


.. py:function:: report_subjects(nifti_root: pathlib.Path, subjects: Iterable[str]) -> dict[str, Any]

   Print and return ``vwi_bb.nii.gz`` completeness for *subjects*.
